review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: Salary Range: PLN 260,000 - 352,000 PLN Subject to alignment to the responsibilities and duties of the role About The Job Build the simulator that helps engineers understand and optimise collective communication at AI scale. As a Senior Software Engineer in the Collectives Simulator team, you will design and develop a large-scale simulator for new AI hardware. Your work will help engineers analyse network parameters and develop communication algorithms for high bandwidth and low latency. You will lead development across design, implementation, testing and documentation. You will also work with other engineering teams to develop features, troubleshoot complex issues and integrate new hardware with the wider AI ecosystem. The role combines large-scale software engineering with custom hardware and communication systems. You will shape technical direction, mentor junior engineers and help build the software that enables efficient communication at very high scale. The team and culture We value face-to-face interaction and make time to meet in the office frequently. The team works in two-week sprints, with three stand-ups each week, fortnightly sprint planning and a weekly team meeting. Work is planned with input from the Technical Product Manager, covering both longer-term priorities and upcoming sprints. Engineers typically work in small groups on larger tasks or components, coordinating the work among themselves. The team has a high level of technical expertise, with opportunities to attend thematic conferences and team outings roughly once a quarter.
